/* OpusMC 用户模组：数据段 */
(function () {
  var list = (window.__BUILTIN_MODS || []).slice();
  try { list = list.concat(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('yymc-usermods') || '[]') || []); } catch (e) {}
  if (!list.length) return;
  // 安全 ID 起始段：原版方块 0~1000，原版物品 0~1100。模组方块从 1200 起，模组物品从 4000 起
  var baseB = 1200, baseI = 4000;
  try { for (var k in BID) { var v = BID[k]; if (typeof v === 'number' && v + 1 > baseB) baseB = v + 1; } } catch (e) {}
  try { for (var k2 in ITEM_KEY) { var v2 = ITEM_KEY[k2]; if (typeof v2 === 'number' && v2 + 1 > baseI) baseI = v2 + 1; } } catch (e) {}
  var od = OpusMC.data, slot = 0;
  OpusMC.data = function (id, def) {
    var m = OpusMC.mods[id];
    if (!m || !m.ids) {
      var ids = { blocks: {}, items: {} }, i = 0, j = 0, bk, ik;
      for (bk in (def.blocks || {})) { ids.blocks[bk] = baseB + slot * 128 + (i++); }
      for (ik in (def.items || {})) { ids.items[ik] = baseI + slot * 128 + (j++); }
      OpusMC._prelude(id, { ids: ids, textures: def.textures || [], name: def.name || id });
    }
    return od(id, def);
  };
  for (var n = 0; n < list.length; n++) {
    var mod = list[n];
    try {
      if (mod.textures) {
        for (var tn in mod.textures) {
          var tv = mod.textures[tn];
          if (typeof tv === 'string' && !tv.startsWith('data:') && !tv.startsWith('blob:')) {
            tv = 'data:image/png;base64,' + tv;
          }
          window.__MODFILES['mods/' + mod.id + '/textures/' + tn] = tv;
          var pure = tn.replace(/\.png$/i, '');
          window.__MODFILES['mods/' + mod.id + '/textures/' + pure] = tv;
          window.__MODFILES['mods/' + mod.id + '/textures/' + pure + '.png'] = tv;
        }
      }
      if (mod.dataJs) eval(mod.dataJs);
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[OpusMC 模组] ' + mod.id + ' 数据出错：', e); }
    slot++;
  }
})();

    door: !!o.door,
    trapdoor: !!o.trapdoor,
    ladder: !!o.ladder,
    gate: !!o.gate,
    collide: o.collide || null,
    slow: o.slow || 0,
    fence: o.fence || null,
    xp: o.xp || null,
    portal: !!o.portal
  };
  b.opaque = (_o$opaque = o.opaque) !== null && _o$opaque !== void 0 ? _o$opaque : shape === SH_CUBE && b.render === 'opaque';
  b.opacity = (_o$opacity = o.opacity) !== null && _o$opacity !== void 0 ? _o$opacity : b.opaque ? 15 : 0;
  const t = o.tex;
  if (o.texFaces) b.tex = o.texFaces.map(T);else if (typeof t === 'string') b.tex.fill(T(t));else if (t) {
    const side = t.side ? T(t.side) : 0;
    b.tex = [side, side, T(t.bottom || t.top || t.side), T(t.top || t.side), side, side];
    if (t.front) b.texFront = T(t.front);
    if (t.frontOn) b.texFrontOn = T(t.frontOn);
  }
  if (o.overlay) b.overlay = [T(o.overlay), T(o.overlay), 0, 0, T(o.overlay), T(o.overlay)];
  b.particle = o.particle ? T(o.particle) : b.tex[0];
  if (o.particle) b.particleOwn = true; // (the model's own "particle" texture beats texFn: a grass block's is dirt)
  if (b.texFront && !o.texFn) {
    b.texFn = (face, meta) => face === (meta & 7) ? meta & 8 && b.texFrontOn ? b.texFrontOn : b.texFront : b.tex[face];
  }
  BLOCKS[id] = b;
  BID[key] = id;
  if (!b.noItem) {
    ITEMS[id] = {
      id,
      key,
      cn,
      block: id,
      stack: o.stack || 64,
      fuel: b.fuel,
      flat: o.flatIcon || null
    };
    ITEM_KEY[key] = id;
  }
  return b;
}

// ---- helpers for drops -----------------------------------------------------
const drop = (key, n = 1) => () => [[key, n]];
const nothing = () => [];

// Axis textures: logs rotate their texture
function logTex(face, meta) {
  const a = meta & 3; // 0 y, 1 x, 2 z
  const b = this;
  if (a === 0) return b.tex[face];
  if (a === 1) return face === 0 || face === 1 ? b.tex[3] : b.tex[0];
  return face === 4 || face === 5 ? b.tex[3] : b.tex[0];
}

// Box shapes (units of 1/16)
const SLAB_BOXES = [[[0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16]], [[0, 8, 0, 16, 16, 16]], [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]]];
function stairBoxes(meta) {
  const f = meta & 3,
    top = meta & 4;
  const base = top ? [0, 8, 0, 16, 16, 16] : [0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16];
  const y0 = top ? 0 : 8,
    y1 = top ? 8 : 16;
  // f: 0 = high side east(+x), 1 = west(-x), 2 = south(+z), 3 = north(-z)
  const step = [[8, y0, 0, 16, y1, 16], [0, y0, 0, 8, y1, 16], [0, y0, 8, 16, y1, 16], [0, y0, 0, 16, y1, 8]][f];
  return [base, step];
}
// collision / selection box = bounds of the vanilla model for this state (doors, trapdoors)
const _modelBoxCache = new Map();
function modelBoxes(b, meta) {
  const k = b.id * 256 + meta;
  let r = _modelBoxCache.get(k);
  if (r) return r;
  if (typeof VM === 'undefined' || !VM.ready) return null;
  const st = vanillaState(b, meta, null);
  const lo = [1, 1, 1],
    hi = [0, 0, 0];
  for (const qs of VM.select(st.key, st.p, 0)) for (const q of qs) for (const p of q.p) for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    lo[i] = Math.min(lo[i], p[i]);
    hi[i] = Math.max(hi[i], p[i]);
  }
  r = hi[0] > lo[0] ? [[lo[0], lo[1], lo[2], hi[0], hi[1], hi[2]].map(v => Math.round(v * 16))] : [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]];
  _modelBoxCache.set(k, r);
  return r;
}
function doorBoxes(meta) {
  const mb = modelBoxes(BLOCKS[69], meta & ~8);
  if (mb) return mb;
  // meta: bits0-1 facing (0 E,1 W,2 S,3 N) bit2 open, bit3 upper
  let f = meta & 3;
  if (meta & 4) f = [2, 3, 1, 0][f];
  return [[[0, 0, 0, 3, 16, 16], [13, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16], [0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 3], [0, 0, 13, 16, 16, 16]][f]];
}
function ladderBoxes(meta) {
  // meta = dir index of the wall it's attached to
  return [{
    0: [0, 0, 0, 2, 16, 16],
    1: [14, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16],
    4: [0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 2],
    5: [0, 0, 14, 16, 16, 16]
  }[meta] || [0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 2]];
}

// chest meta: bits0-2 facing (face index of the front), bit3 unopened loot, bit4 left half, bit5 right half
function chestType(m) {
  return m & 16 ? 1 : m & 32 ? 2 : 0;
}
function chestSeam(m) {
  // [dx, dz] towards the other half of a double chest
  const t = chestType(m);
  if (!t) return null;
  const L = {
    5: [-1, 0],
    4: [1, 0],
    1: [0, 1],
    0: [0, -1]
  }[m & 7] || [-1, 0];
  return t === 1 ? L : [-L[0], -L[1]];
}
function chestBoxes(m) {
  const b = [1, 0, 1, 15, 14, 15],
    s = chestSeam(m);
  if (s) {
    if (s[0] < 0) b[0] = 0;
    if (s[0] > 0) b[3] = 16;
    if (s[1] < 0) b[2] = 0;
    if (s[1] > 0) b[5] = 16;
  }
  return [b];
}

// ---- Nether / End / structure blocks -----------------------------------------
function fenceBoxes(m) {
  const b = [[6, 0, 6, 10, 16, 10]];
  if (m & 1) b.push([0, 6, 7, 6, 9, 9], [0, 12, 7, 6, 15, 9]);
  if (m & 2) b.push([10, 6, 7, 16, 9, 9], [10, 12, 7, 16, 15, 9]);
  if (m & 4) b.push([7, 6, 0, 9, 9, 6], [7, 12, 0, 9, 15, 6]);
  if (m & 8) b.push([7, 6, 10, 9, 9, 16], [7, 12, 10, 9, 15, 16]);
  return b;
}
function fenceCollide(m) {
  const b = [[6, 0, 6, 10, 24, 10]];
  if (m & 1) b.push([0, 0, 6, 6, 24, 10]);
  if (m & 2) b.push([10, 0, 6, 16, 24, 10]);
  if (m & 4) b.push([6, 0, 0, 10, 24, 6]);
  if (m & 8) b.push([6, 0, 10, 10, 24, 16]);
  return b;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Data-driven blocks (tools/build_blocks.py -> blockdata.js): terrain & vegetation of the
// vanilla 1.18+ generator. Plain cubes use the fast cube path; everything else is drawn from its
// baked vanilla model, with meta = index into the block's list of blockstate property sets.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const SOUND_GROUP = {
  basalt: 'basalt',
  wood: 'wood',
  cherry_wood: 'wood',
  mangrove_roots: 'wood',
  beehive: 'wood',
  bamboo: 'wood',
  creaking_heart: 'wood',
  gravel: 'gravel',
  mud: 'gravel',
  rooted_dirt: 'gravel',
  muddy_mangrove_roots: 'gravel',
  powder_snow: 'snow',
  glass: 'glass',
  sand: 'sand'
};
const GRASSY = /grass|moss|leaves|sapling|vine|lichen|berry|dripleaf|roots|azalea|blossom|petals|litter|flower|lily_pad|crop|slime/;
// the newer half-transparent blocks that hide faces shared with their own kind (vanilla HalfTransparentBlock /
// PowderSnowBlock skipRendering)
const CULL_SAME_GEN = new Set(['powder_snow', 'tinted_glass', 'slime_block', 'honey_block']);
// the vanilla leaves loot tables without shears or silk touch: the sapling 1/20 (jungle 1/40, mangroves have none),
// sticks 1/50 (1-2), apples 1/200 from oak and dark oak. Without these the newer leaves dropped themselves - every
// decayed leaf an item of leaves
const LEAF_SAPLING = {
  jungle_leaves: 'jungle_sapling',
  acacia_leaves: 'acacia_sapling',
  dark_oak_leaves: 'dark_oak_sapling',
  cherry_leaves: 'cherry_sapling',
  azalea_leaves: 'azalea',
  flowering_azalea_leaves: 'flowering_azalea',
  pale_oak_leaves: 'pale_oak_sapling'
};
function leafDrops(key) {
  const sap = LEAF_SAPLING[key],
    sapChance = key === 'jungle_leaves' ? 1 / 40 : 1 / 20,
    apple = key === 'dark_oak_leaves';
  return (m, r) => {
    const d = [];
    if (sap && r() < sapChance) d.push([sap, 1]);
    if (r() < 0.02) d.push(['stick', 1 + (r() * 2 | 0)]);
    if (apple && r() < 0.005) d.push(['apple', 1]);
    return d;
  };
}
// walls / panes: selection = model bounds for the connection bits, walls collide 1.5 blocks high
function connBoxes(b, m) {
  return modelBoxes(b, m) || [[4, 0, 4, 12, 16, 12]];
}
function wallCollide(m) {
  const b = [[4, 0, 4, 12, 24, 12]];
  if (m & 1) b.push([0, 0, 5, 4, 24, 11]);
  if (m & 2) b.push([12, 0, 5, 16, 24, 11]);
  if (m & 4) b.push([5, 0, 0, 11, 24, 4]);
  if (m & 8) b.push([5, 0, 12, 11, 24, 16]);
  return b;
}
// fence gates: solid 1.5 blocks high across the gate's axis while closed
function gateCollide(m) {
  const b = BLOCKS[this.id],
    s = b && b.states && b.states[m];
  if (!s || s.open === 'true') return [];
  return s.facing === 'east' || s.facing === 'west' ? [[6, 0, 0, 10, 24, 16]] : [[0, 0, 6, 16, 24, 10]];
}
// selection / collision boxes of the block-entity blocks, by kind and state
function entityBoxes(b, m) {
  const st = b.states && b.states[m] || {},
    f = st.facing;
  const wall = box => {
    // a box against the wall behind a north-facing block, turned to the facing
    const [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] = box;
    return f === 'south' ? [x0, y0, 16 - z1, x1, y1, 16 - z0] : f === 'west' ? [z0, y0, x0, z1, y1, x1] : f === 'east' ? [16 - z1, y0, x0, 16 - z0, y1, x1] : box;
  };
  switch (b.be) {
    case 'head':
      return [[4, 0, 4, 12, 8, 12]];
    case 'wall_head':
      return [wall([4, 4, 8, 12, 12, 16])];
    case 'banner':
      return [[4, 0, 4, 12, 16, 12]];
    case 'wall_banner':
      return [wall([0, 0, 14, 16, 12.5, 16])];
    case 'decorated_pot':
      return [[1, 0, 1, 15, 16, 15]];
    case 'conduit':
      return [[5, 5, 5, 11, 11, 11]];
    case 'golem_statue':
      return [[2, 0, 2, 14, 14, 14]];
    case 'invisible':
      return b.key === 'barrier' ? [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]] : [];
  }
  return [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]];
}
function defDataBlock(d) {
  const o = {
    hardness: d.hardness,
    tool: d.tool || null,
    level: d.level || 0,
    needsTool: !!d.needsTool,
    light: d.light || 0,
    fuel: d.fuel || 0,
    damage: d.damage || 0,
    slip: d.slip || 0.6,
    climbable: !!d.climbable,
    replaceable: !!d.replaceable,
    noItem: !!d.noitem
  };
  o.sound = d.sound; // a vanilla sound group; audio.js falls back to a similar material when it has no events
  if (d.tint) o.tint = d.tint;
  if (d.drop === 'none') o.drops = nothing;else if (d.drop) o.drops = drop(d.drop);
  if (d.ore) {
    const [a, b] = d.oreCount || [1, 1];
    o.drops = (m, r) => [[ITEM_KEY[d.ore] !== undefined ? d.ore : d.key, a + (r() * (b - a + 1) | 0)]];
  }
  if (d.xp) o.xp = d.xp;
  // a mod's fluid (mods.js): drawn and flowing like water or lava, its own still texture
  if (d.kind === 'fluid') {
    const b = defBlock(d.id, d.key, d.cn, {
      shape: SH_LIQUID,
      tex: d.still,
      render: d.hot ? 'opaque' : 'translucent',
      solid: false,
      opacity: d.hot ? 15 : 1,
      light: d.light || 0,
      hardness: -1,
      replaceable: true,
      noItem: true,
      cullSame: true
    });
    b.fluidKind = d.hot ? 'lava' : 'water';
    if (d.bucket) b.bucket = d.bucket; // (set on the block: defBlock keeps only the fields it knows)
    b.soundGroup = d.hot ? 'lava' : 'water';
    return b;
  }
  if (d.kind === 'entity') {
    // drawn by blockents.js; the boxes are for selection and collision
    Object.assign(o, {
      shape: SH_BOXES,
      beRender: d.be !== 'invisible',
      be: d.be,
      render: 'cutout',
      opaque: false,
      opacity: 0,
      solid: !d.nonsolid,
      tex: d.particle || 'white'
    });
    if (d.be === 'chest') Object.assign(o, {
      facing: true,
      chestLike: true,
      boxes: chestBoxes,
      onUse: d.key === 'ender_chest' ? null : 'chest'
    });else o.boxes = m => entityBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m);
    const b = defBlock(d.id, d.key, d.cn, o);
    if (d.states && d.be !== 'chest') b.states = d.states;
    if (d.key === 'light') b.stateLight = (d.states || []).map(s => +s.level || 0);
    b.soundGroup = d.sound;
    return b;
  }
  if (d.kind === 'cube') {
    o.texFaces = d.tex;
    if (d.axis) {
      o.axis = true;
      o.texFn = logTex;
      o.flammable = true;
    }
    if (d.log) o.fuel = /crimson|warped/.test(d.key) ? 0 : 300; // (nether stems and hyphae don't burn in vanilla)
    if (d.leaves) Object.assign(o, {
      render: 'cutout',
      opaque: false,
      opacity: 1,
      flammable: true,
      drops: leafDrops(d.key)
    });
    if (d.translucent) Object.assign(o, {
      render: 'translucent',
      opaque: false,
      opacity: 1
    });
    if (d.cutout) Object.assign(o, {
      render: 'cutout',
      opaque: false,
      opacity: 0
    });
  } else {
    Object.assign(o, {
      shape: SH_MODEL,
      render: d.translucent ? 'translucent' : 'cutout',
      opaque: false,
      opacity: 0,
      particle: d.particle
    });
    if (d.plant || d.nonsolid) o.solid = false;
    if (d.plant) o.needsSupport = true;
    // built-in behaviours share the legacy blocks' meta layout and shapes
    if (d.stairs) Object.assign(o, {
      stairs: true,
      boxes: stairBoxes
    });else if (d.slab) Object.assign(o, {
      slab: true,
      boxes: m => SLAB_BOXES[m & 3],
      drops: slabDrop(d.key)
    });else if (d.fence) Object.assign(o, {
      fence: d.fence,
      boxes: fenceBoxes,
      collide: fenceCollide
    });else if (d.wall) Object.assign(o, {
      fence: 'wall',
      boxes: m => connBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m),
      collide: wallCollide
    });else if (d.pane) Object.assign(o, {
      fence: 'pane',
      boxes: m => connBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m)
    });else if (d.door) Object.assign(o, {
      door: true,
      noItem: true,
      boxes: m => modelBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m & ~8) || [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 3]],
      drops: m => m & 8 ? [] : [[d.key, 1]]
    });else if (d.trapdoor) Object.assign(o, {
      trapdoor: true,
      boxes: m => modelBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m) || [[0, 0, 0, 16, 3, 16]]
    });else if (d.bed) Object.assign(o, {
      bed: true,
      stack: 1,
      boxes: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 9, 16]],
      drops: m => m & 4 ? [] : [[d.key, 1]]
    });else if (d.gate) Object.assign(o, {
      gate: true,
      boxes: m => modelBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m) || [[0, 0, 6, 16, 16, 10]],
      collide: gateCollide
    });else o.boxes = m => modelBoxes(BLOCKS[d.id], m) || [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]];
  }
  if (CULL_SAME_GEN.has(d.key)) o.cullSame = true;else if (d.cullSame) o.cullSame = true; // (a mod's glass: no faces between two of its own - mods.js)
  // powder snow's picture has no see-through pixels: drawn as translucent (no depth), its two-sided faces showed
  // through one another - holes in a flat field of it (players' feedback 2026-10-31「细雪显示bug」)
  if (d.key === 'powder_snow') o.render = 'cutout';
  const b = defBlock(d.id, d.key, d.cn, o);
  if (d.states) b.states = d.states;
  // lit / unlit states (candles give 3 per candle)
  if (d.states && d.light && d.states.some(s => 'lit' in s)) b.stateLight = d.states.map(s => s.lit === 'true' ? s.candles ? 3 * +s.candles : d.light : 0);
  if (d.stateLight) b.stateLight = d.stateLight; // (a mod's blocks: the light of each state, given - mods.js)
  b.soundGroup = d.sound;
  if (d.tint && d.tint[0] === '#') b.tintRGB = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(d.tint.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
  // (a mod's block fields the data has no word for, set here so the workers have them too: waterlogged - always in
  // water, as seagrass; waterloggable - can hold water, as the WATERLOGGABLE_RE blocks; 农夫乐事's rice)
  if (d.props) Object.assign(b, d.props);
  return b;
}
for (const d of self.BLOCK_DATA || []) defDataBlock(d);
// redstone dust's power (0-15) is part of its vanilla state, but its 81 connection states already fill the meta:
// power 1-15 are blocks of their own (ids 4081-4095, the same model and connections, vanilla's colour for the
// level), so the power is saved with the world. WIRE_ID[p] is the block for power p; BLOCKS[id].wirePower its power.
const WIRE_ID = [];
function wireColor(p) {
  const f = p / 15;
  return [f * 0.6 + (f > 0 ? 0.4 : 0.3), clamp(f * f * 0.7 - 0.5, 0, 1), clamp(f * f * 0.6 - 0.7, 0, 1)].map(v => Math.round(v * 255));
}
if (BID.redstone_wire !== undefined) {
  const w = BLOCKS[BID.redstone_wire];
  Object.assign(w, {
    tint: 'rgb',
    tintRGB: wireColor(0),
    wirePower: 0
  });
  WIRE_ID[0] = w.id;
  for (let p = 1; p <= 15; p++) {
    const id = 4080 + p;
    BLOCKS[id] = Object.assign(Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(w)), w, {
      id,
      tintRGB: wireColor(p),
      wirePower: p
    });
    WIRE_ID[p] = id;
  }
}
if (BID.barrel !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.barrel].onUse = 'barrel';
// a lily pad can be stood on (its 1.5-pixel box collides, like vanilla). (A sweet berry bush holds whoever goes
// through it back: entity.js, Living.baseTick)
if (BID.lily_pad !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.lily_pad].solid = true;
// the data blocks' colours as vanilla's BlockColors: a tinted model face (tintindex) of a block with none there is drawn
// as it is (vmodels.js) - the stonecutter's blade, bamboo, lava and powder snow in a cauldron were grass-green, and so was
// leaf litter (its dry foliage colour), the cauldron's water, the stems (their age's colour)
for (const [k, t] of [['water_cauldron', 'water'], ['leaf_litter', 'dry_foliage'], ['melon_stem', 'stem'], ['pumpkin_stem', 'stem'], ['attached_melon_stem', '#e0c71c'], ['attached_pumpkin_stem', '#e0c71c'], ['lava_cauldron', null], ['powder_snow_cauldron', null]]) {
  const b = BLOCKS[BID[k]];
  if (!b) continue;
  b.tint = t;
  delete b.tintRGB;
  if (t && t[0] === '#') b.tintRGB = [1, 3, 5].map(i => parseInt(t.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
}
// (vanilla BlockTintSources.stem)
function stemTint(age) {
  age = +age || 0;
  return [age * 32, 255 - age * 8, age * 4];
}
// blocks with vanilla's snowy state (SnowyDirtBlock: Game.snowyUpdate; the grass block's is meta bit 1)
const SNOWY_DIRT = new Set([2, BID.podzol, BID.mycelium].filter(i => i !== undefined));
// pink petals and wildflowers tint only their stems (layer 1): their particles (layer 0) are not tinted
for (const k of ['pink_petals', 'wildflowers']) if (BID[k] !== undefined) Object.assign(BLOCKS[BID[k]], {
  tint: 'grass',
  particleTint: false
});
if (BID.soul_fire !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID.soul_fire].replaceable = true; // (like fire: a block put there, water flowing in takes it)
// vanilla's shapes where the model's bounds are wrong (getShape / getCollisionShape): the flames of a lit campfire and
// the stonecutter's saw made them a whole block high, the sculk sensor's tendrils too, a tripwire's flat model gave a
// box nothing could hit (it couldn't be mined). A block that isn't solid but has a collide is still stood on and
// bumped into (entity.js blockBoxes): bamboo, end rods, azaleas, the big dripleaf's leaf, the shrieker had none -
// they stay non-solid for everything else (support, fluids, mob paths)
// (the feet slot: a player's inventory slot 39 - 36..39 are head..feet - a mob's armorItems[3])
function wearsLeatherBoots(e) {
  const s = e.inv ? e.inv.slots[39] : e.armorItems && e.armorItems[3];
  return !!(s && ITEMS[s.id] && ITEMS[s.id].key === 'leather_boots');
}
{
  const set = (k, o) => {
    if (BID[k] !== undefined) Object.assign(BLOCKS[BID[k]], o);
  };
  const prop = (k, m, p) => {
    const s = BLOCKS[BID[k]].states;
    return s && s[m] ? s[m][p] : undefined;
  };
  for (const k of ['campfire', 'soul_campfire']) set(k, {
    boxes: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 7, 16]]
  });
  set('stonecutter', {
    boxes: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 9, 16]]
  });
  for (const k of ['sculk_sensor', 'calibrated_sculk_sensor']) set(k, {
    boxes: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16]],
    collide: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16]]
  });
  set('sculk_shrieker', {
    collide: () => [[0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16]]
  });
  set('tripwire', {
    boxes: m => prop('tripwire', m, 'attached') === 'true' ? [[0, 1, 0, 16, 2.5, 16]] : [[0, 0, 0, 16, 8, 16]]
  });
  set('bamboo', {
    collide: () => [[6.5, 0, 6.5, 9.5, 16, 9.5]]
  });
  set('end_rod', {
    collide: m => {
      const f = prop('end_rod', m, 'facing');
      return f === 'east' || f === 'west' ? [[0, 6, 6, 16, 10, 10]] : f === 'north' || f === 'south' ? [[6, 6, 0, 10, 10, 16]] : [[6, 0, 6, 10, 16, 10]];
    }
  });
  for (const k of ['azalea', 'flowering_azalea']) set(k, {
    collide: () => [[0, 8, 0, 16, 16, 16], [6, 0, 6, 10, 8, 10]]
  });
  set('big_dripleaf', {
    collide: m => {
      const t = prop('big_dripleaf', m, 'tilt');
      return t === 'full' ? [] : [[0, 11, 0, 16, t === 'partial' ? 13 : 15, 16]];
    }
  });
  // snow layers: a layer less than they show (none for one)
  // (shared arrays: one-layer snow covers every snowy biome and blockBoxes runs for every mob each tick)
  const SNOW = [[]];
  for (let l = 1; l < 8; l++) SNOW.push([[0, 0, 0, 16, 2 * l, 16]]);
  set('snow', {
    collide: m => SNOW[m & 7]
  });
  // honey: a little narrower and lower than a block, slows (0.4) and halves jumps; whoever slides down its side is
  // held (entity.js). Slime throws back up whoever lands on it (entity.js)
  set('honey_block', {
    collide: () => [[1, 0, 1, 15, 15, 15]],
    slow: 0.4,
    jumpFactor: 0.5
  });
  set('slime_block', {
    bounce: 1,
    slip: 0.8
  });
  // powder snow (PowderSnowBlock.getCollisionShape): 0.9 high under anything falling more than 2.5 blocks (caught, no
  // fall damage), a whole block under a falling block, and under one in leather boots (rabbits, foxes, endermites,
  // silverfish too) that is above it and not sneaking; nothing for the rest, who sink into it
  const PS_FALL = [[0, 0, 0, 16, 14.4, 16]],
    PS_FULL = [[0, 0, 0, 16, 16, 16]],
    NONE = [];
  const walker = e => /^(rabbit|endermite|silverfish|fox)$/.test(e.type || '') || wearsLeatherBoots(e);
  set('powder_snow', {
    collide: (m, e, y) => !e ? NONE : e.fallDist > 2.5 ? PS_FALL : typeof FallingBlock !== 'undefined' && e instanceof FallingBlock || e.pos[1] > y + 1 - 1e-5 && !e.sneaking && !e.sneakHeld && walker(e) ? PS_FULL : NONE
  });
}
// plants that only exist under water render (and behave) as if their cell were also water; like vanilla they
// are cutout, so the translucent water drawn after them tints them
// (not sea pickles: they hold water only when waterlogged, like vanilla's - on land one brought its own water)
for (const k of ['seagrass', 'tall_seagrass', 'kelp', 'kelp_plant', 'tube_coral', 'brain_coral', 'bubble_coral', 'fire_coral', 'horn_coral', 'tube_coral_fan', 'brain_coral_fan', 'bubble_coral_fan', 'fire_coral_fan', 'horn_coral_fan', 'tube_coral_wall_fan', 'brain_coral_wall_fan', 'bubble_coral_wall_fan', 'fire_coral_wall_fan', 'horn_coral_wall_fan']) if (BID[k] !== undefined) Object.assign(BLOCKS[BID[k]], {
  waterlogged: true,
  render: 'cutout',
  solid: false,
  replaceable: k.includes('seagrass')
});
// vanilla block loot the data has no word for (its loot tables): what drops itself only to silk touch (or shears) or

(() => {
  const fortune = t => typeof enchLevel === 'function' ? Math.min(3, enchLevel(t, 'fortune')) : 0;

  });

  };

function fixSavedStack(s) {
  if (!s || ITEMS[s.id]) return s;
  const b = BLOCKS[s.id],
    to = b && ITEM_KEY[LEGACY_ITEM[b.key]];
  return to !== undefined ? {
    ...s,
    id: to
  } : null;
}
// two stacks that may merge: the same item, and the same potion (or other data) if they carry one
function sameKind(a, b) {
  var _a$mapId, _b$mapId;
  // (maps: each its own - a drawn map took every new one in creative, two maps stacked as one in survival)
  return a.id === b.id && (a.pot || '') === (b.pot || '') && (a.x || '') === (b.x || '') && (a.name || '') === (b.name || '') && (a.rc || 0) === (b.rc || 0) && JSON.stringify(a.trim || null) === JSON.stringify(b.trim || null) && ((_a$mapId = a.mapId) !== null && _a$mapId !== void 0 ? _a$mapId : null) === ((_b$mapId = b.mapId) !== null && _b$mapId !== void 0 ? _b$mapId : null) && (!a.e && !b.e || !!a.e && !!b.e && sameEnchants(a, b));
}
function item(key) {
  const id = ITEM_KEY[key];
  if (id === undefined) throw new Error('no item ' + key);
  return id;
}
function itemDef(id) {
  return ITEMS[id];
}
function makeStack(key, count = 1) {
  const id = typeof key === 'number' ? key : item(key);
  return {
    id,
    count,
    dmg: 0
  };
}
function maxStack(id) {
  return ITEMS[id] ? ITEMS[id].stack : 64;
}

function shaped(result, count, pattern, keys) {
  const k = {};
  for (const c in keys) k[c] = (TAGS[keys[c]] || [keys[c]]).map(item);
  RECIPES.push({
    type: 'shaped',
    result: item(result),
    count,
    pattern,
    keys: k,
    w: pattern[0].length,
    h: pattern.length
  });
}
function shapeless(result, count, ingredients) {
  RECIPES.push({
    type: 'shapeless',
    result: item(result),
    count,
    ing: ingredients.map(i => (TAGS[i] || [i]).map(item))
  });
}

// Match a crafting grid (array of stacks|null, width w) against recipes
function matchRecipe(grid, w) {
  const h = grid.length / w;
  // find bounding box
  let minX = w,
    minY = h,
    maxX = -1,
    maxY = -1,
    n = 0;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (grid[y * w + x]) {
    n++;
    minX = Math.min(minX, x);
    maxX = Math.max(maxX, x);
    minY = Math.min(minY, y);
    maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);
  }
  if (!n) return null;
  const bw = maxX - minX + 1,
    bh = maxY - minY + 1;
  for (const r of RECIPES) {
    if (r.type === 'shaped') {
      if (r.w !== bw || r.h !== bh) continue;
      for (const mirror of [false, true]) {
        let ok = true;
        for (let y = 0; y < bh && ok; y++) for (let x = 0; x < bw && ok; x++) {
          const c = r.pattern[y][mirror ? bw - 1 - x : x];
          const s = grid[(minY + y) * w + minX + x];
          if (c === ' ' || c === undefined) {
            if (s) ok = false;
          } else if (!s || !r.keys[c].includes(s.id)) ok = false;
        }
        if (ok) return r;
      }
    } else {
      if (r.ing.length !== n) continue;
      const used = new Array(r.ing.length).fill(false);
      let ok = true;
      for (const s of grid) {
        if (!s) continue;
        let found = false;
        for (let i = 0; i < r.ing.length; i++) if (!used[i] && r.ing[i].includes(s.id)) {
          used[i] = true;
          found = true;
          break;
        }
        if (!found) {
          ok = false;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (ok) return r;
    }
  }
  return null;
}
const SMELTING = {};
function smelt(a, b, xp = 0.1) {
  SMELTING[item(a)] = {
    result: item(b),
    xp
  };
}

// vanilla's recipes (tools/build_recipes.py -> recipedata.js) replace the hand-written ones above: crafting,
// cooking in the furnace / blast furnace / smoker / campfire, the stonecutter and the smithing table
const COOKING = {
    smelting: SMELTING,
    blasting: {},
    smoking: {},
    campfire_cooking: {}
  },
  STONECUTTING = {},
  SMITHING = [];
// an ingredient (item key, '#tag' or a list of those) -> the item ids it stands for
function itemIds(v) {
  if (v == null) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return [...new Set(v.flatMap(itemIds))];
  if (v[0] === '#') return [...new Set((self.RECIPE_DATA && RECIPE_DATA.tags[v.slice(1)] || []).flatMap(itemIds))];
  // every item of that name: 47 names are both one of this game's first blocks and the vanilla import (white wool: 128
  // and 1995) - a recipe took only the latter, the wool sheared or mined was the former: no bed (players' feedback
  // 2026-10-31, the most reported)
  if (!itemIds.byKey) {
    itemIds.byKey = {};
    for (const d of ITEMS) if (d && d.key) (itemIds.byKey[d.key] = itemIds.byKey[d.key] || []).push(d.id);
  }
  const all = itemIds.byKey[v];
  if (all) return all.slice();
  const id = ITEM_KEY[v];
  return id === undefined ? [] : [id];
}
(function loadRecipes() {
  const D = self.RECIPE_DATA;
  if (!D) return;
  const ids = itemIds;
  RECIPES.length = 0;
  for (const k in SMELTING) delete SMELTING[k];
  for (const r of D.crafting) {
    const res = ITEM_KEY[r[1]];
    if (res === undefined) continue;
    if (r[0] === 's') {
      const keys = {};
      let ok = true;
      for (const c in r[4]) {
        keys[c] = ids(r[4][c]);
        if (!keys[c].length) ok = false;
      }
      // empty rows and columns at the edges dropped, as vanilla's ShapedRecipePattern.shrink (the spyglass is
      // ' # ', ' X ', ' X ': matched against the grid's filled box, it was never made)
      let p = r[3].slice();
      while (p.length && !p[0].trim()) p.shift();
      while (p.length && !p[p.length - 1].trim()) p.pop();
      const full = p.filter(s => s.trim()),
        a = Math.min(...full.map(s => s.search(/\S/))),
        b = Math.max(...full.map(s => s.trimEnd().length));
      p = p.map(s => s.slice(a, b).padEnd(b - a));
      if (ok && p.length) RECIPES.push({
        type: 'shaped',
        result: res,
        count: r[2],
        pattern: p,
        keys,
        w: p[0].length,
        h: p.length
      });
    } else {
      const ing = r[0] === 'l' ? r[3].map(ids) : [ids(r[2]), ids(r[3])];
      // transmute (dyeing a shulker box or bundle): the result keeps the first ingredient's other data
      if (ing.every(a => a.length)) RECIPES.push({
        type: 'shapeless',
        result: res,
        count: r[0] === 'l' ? r[2] : 1,
        ing,
        keep: r[0] === 't' ? 0 : undefined
      });
    }
  }
  for (const [kind, i, r, xp, time] of D.cooking) {
    const res = ITEM_KEY[r];
    if (res === undefined) continue;
    for (const id of ids(i)) COOKING[kind][id] = {
      result: res,
      xp,
      time
    };
  }
  for (const [i, r, n] of D.stonecutting) {
    const res = ITEM_KEY[r];
    if (res === undefined) continue;
    for (const id of ids(i)) (STONECUTTING[id] = STONECUTTING[id] || []).push({
      result: res,
      count: n
    });
  }
  for (const [t, tp, base, add, r] of D.smithing) SMITHING.push({
    trim: t === 'trim',
    template: ids(tp),
    base: ids(base),
    addition: ids(add),
    result: t === 'trim' ? null : ITEM_KEY[r],
    pattern: t === 'trim' ? r : null
  });
})();
// furnaces of each kind cook their own recipes; blast furnaces and smokers twice as fast (fuel lasts half as long)
const FURNACE_KIND = {
  furnace: 'smelting',
  lit_furnace: 'smelting',
  blast_furnace: 'blasting',
  smoker: 'smoking'
};
for (const k of ['blast_furnace', 'smoker']) if (BID[k] !== undefined) BLOCKS[BID[k]].onUse = 'furnace';
// vanilla FuelValues (ticks; 200 smelts one item) for what this game had none for - leaf litter, bamboo, scaffolding,
// carpets, boats, bowls, dried kelp blocks ... (players' feedback 2026-10-31: leaf litter would not burn). Filled in
// once, on the first look-up (every item is defined by then); fuel already set stays. Crimson and warped don't burn
const VANILLA_FUEL = (() => {
  const W = '(oak|spruce|birch|jungle|acacia|dark_oak|mangrove|cherry|pale_oak|bamboo)';
  const COL = '(white|orange|magenta|light_blue|yellow|lime|pink|gray|light_gray|cyan|purple|blue|brown|green|red|black)';
  return [[new RegExp(`^(stripped_)?${W}_(log|wood)$|^${W}_planks$|^(stripped_)?bamboo_block$|^bamboo_mosaic(_stairs)?$|^${W}_(stairs|trapdoor|pressure_plate|fence|fence_gate|shelf)$`), 300], [/^(note_block|bookshelf|chiseled_bookshelf|lectern|jukebox|chest|trapped_chest|crafting_table|daylight_detector|bow|fishing_rod|ladder|crossbow|loom|barrel|cartography_table|fletching_table|smithing_table|composter|mangrove_roots)$/, 300], [new RegExp(`^${COL}_banner$`), 300], [new RegExp(`^${W}_slab$|^bamboo_mosaic_slab$`), 150], [new RegExp(`^${W}_hanging_sign$`), 800], [new RegExp(`^${W}_(sign|door)$|^wooden_(shovel|sword|spear|hoe|axe|pickaxe)$`), 200], [new RegExp(`^${W}_(chest_)?(boat|raft)$`), 1200], [new RegExp(`^${COL}_wool$|^${W}_button$|_sapling$|^mangrove_propagule$`), 100], [/^(stick|bowl|dead_bush|short_dry_grass|tall_dry_grass|azalea|flowering_azalea|leaf_litter)$/, 100], [new RegExp(`^${COL}_carpet$`), 67], [/^dried_kelp_block$/, 4001], [/^(bamboo|scaffolding)$/, 50]];
})();
let vanillaFuelDone = false;
function fuelValue(id) {
  if (!vanillaFuelDone) {
    vanillaFuelDone = true;
    for (const d of ITEMS) if (d && !(d.fuel || BLOCKS[d.id] && BLOCKS[d.id].fuel)) {
      const r = VANILLA_FUEL.find(([re]) => re.test(d.key));
      if (r) d.fuel = r[1];
    }
  }
  const d = ITEMS[id];
  return d ? d.fuel || BLOCKS[id] && BLOCKS[id].fuel || 0 : 0;
}

// Creative inventory: vanilla's tabs (top row, then bottom row); each item's tab comes from itemdata.js
const CREATIVE_TABS = [['building_blocks', '建筑方块', 'bricks'], ['colored_blocks', '染色方块', 'cyan_wool'], ['natural_blocks', '自然方块', 'grass_block'], ['functional_blocks', '功能方块', 'oak_sign'], ['redstone_blocks', '红石方块', 'redstone'], ['tools_and_utilities', '工具与实用物品', 'diamond_pickaxe'], ['combat', '战斗用品', 'netherite_sword'], ['food_and_drinks', '食物与饮品', 'golden_apple'], ['ingredients', '原材料', 'iron_ingot'], ['spawn_eggs', '刷怪蛋', 'pig_spawn_egg']].map(([id, name, icon]) => ({
  id,
  name,
  icon,
  get items() {
    return creativeTabItems(id);
  }
}));
function creativeTabItems(tab) {
  const c = creativeTabItems.cache || (creativeTabItems.cache = {});
  if (!c[tab]) c[tab] = (self.ITEM_DATA || []).filter(d => d.tab === tab && ITEM_KEY[d.key] !== undefined).flatMap(d => /^(potion|splash_potion|lingering_potion|tipped_arrow)$/.test(d.key) && typeof POTIONS !== 'undefined' ? Object.keys(POTIONS).filter(p => d.key !== 'tipped_arrow' || POTIONS[p].length).map(pot => ({
    key: d.key,
    pot
  })) : [d.key]);
  return c[tab];
}

// blocks with vanilla's waterlogged property (from the 26.1 block states), less a double slab
const WATERLOGGABLE_RE = /(_stairs|_slab|_wall|_fence|_pane|_bars|_chain|_trapdoor|_sign|_shelf|_leaves|rail|_candle|_lantern|_coral|_coral_fan|_coral_wall_fan|lightning_rod|_grate|_chest|copper_golem_statue)$|^(candle|lantern|chest|ladder|glow_lichen|resin_clump|barrier|light|dried_ghast|sea_pickle|conduit|scaffolding|campfire|soul_campfire|amethyst_cluster|(large|medium|small)_amethyst_bud|sculk_sensor|calibrated_sculk_sensor|sculk_vein|sculk_shrieker|pointed_dripstone|sulfur_spike|big_dripleaf|big_dripleaf_stem|small_dripleaf|hanging_roots|decorated_pot|heavy_core|mangrove_propagule|mangrove_roots)$/;
let WATERLOGGABLE = null;
function canWaterlog(id, meta) {
  if (!WATERLOGGABLE) {
    WATERLOGGABLE = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
    for (const b of BLOCKS) if (b && (WATERLOGGABLE_RE.test(b.key) || b.waterloggable) && !/^(jack_o|sea)_lantern$/.test(b.key)) WATERLOGGABLE[b.id] = 1;
  }
  return !!WATERLOGGABLE[id] && !(BLOCKS[id].slab && (meta & 3) === 2);
}
</script>
<script>
/* ==== js/world.js ==== */
'use strict';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// World: chunk storage, generation, lighting, fluids, block updates
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const OPACITY = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS),
  EMIT = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS),
  SOLIDCUBE = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
const IS_FLUID = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS),
  REPLACEABLE = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
// AO occluders: like vanilla, every full-collision cube darkens corners (opaque ones, but also leaves and glass)
const AOCUBE = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS),
  WLOG = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
const TORCHLIKE = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS); // the torches, standing and on walls (soul, redstone, copper too)
// the four ways a fluid spreads, in vanilla's order (north, east, south, west: k ^ 2 is the way back)
const FLUID_HDIRS = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]];
const FLUID_HDIR_D = [4, 1, 5, 0]; // the same as DIRS indices
// a mod's fluids (mods.js): 1 flows like water, 2 like lava (molten metal); they meet neither water nor lava
const FLUID_MOD = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOCKS; i++) {
  const b = BLOCKS[i];
  if (!b) {
    OPACITY[i] = 15;
    continue;
  }
  OPACITY[i] = b.opacity;
  EMIT[i] = b.light;
  SOLIDCUBE[i] = b.opaque ? 1 : 0;
  AOCUBE[i] = b.opaque || b.shape === SH_CUBE && b.solid && b.render !== 'translucent' ? 1 : 0;
  IS_FLUID[i] = b.shape === SH_LIQUID ? 1 : 0;
  REPLACEABLE[i] = b.replaceable ? 1 : 0;
  WLOG[i] = b.waterlogged ? 1 : 0;
  FLUID_MOD[i] = b.fluidKind === 'water' ? 1 : b.fluidKind === 'lava' ? 2 : 0;
  TORCHLIKE[i] = /(^|_)torch$/.test(b.key || '') && !b.solid ? 1 : 0;
}
// blocks whose light depends on their state (lit campfires, candles, lamps, copper bulbs)
const STATE_EMIT = new Array(MAX_BLOCKS).fill(null);
for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOCKS; i++) if (BLOCKS[i] && BLOCKS[i].stateLight) STATE_EMIT[i] = BLOCKS[i].stateLight;
// blocks that give light only while waterlogged (sea pickles: SeaPickleBlock.isDead); wet = the cell's chunk.wl flag
const WET_EMIT = new Uint8Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOCKS; i++) if (BLOCKS[i] && BLOCKS[i].wetLight) WET_EMIT[i] = 1;
const emitOf = (id, meta, wet) => {
  if (WET_EMIT[id] && !wet) return 0;
  const s = STATE_EMIT[id];
  return s ? s[meta] | 0 : EMIT[id];
};
const AIR = 0,
  WATER = 7,
  LAVA = 8;
function ckey(cx, cz) {
  return (cx + 32768) * 65536 + (cz + 32768);
}

// ---- chunk storage ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Like vanilla's paletted containers, a chunk only stores what it needs. Of a loaded overworld more than half
// the 16^3 sections are all air, meta is all zero in 9 sections of 10 and light is one value in 8 of 10, so
// per section:
//   blocks bs[s]: null (all air) or { p: palette Uint16Array(256), n: entries used, d: Uint8Array(4096) }
//                 (a section with more than 256 different blocks: n = -1, d holds ids, p is the identity)
//   meta   ms[s]: null (all 0) or Uint8Array(4096)
//   light  ls[s]: null (every cell is lu[s]) or Uint8Array(4096), sky << 4 | block
// About a fifth of the flat arrays' size (393 KB a chunk at 384 high). Cells keep the flat index
// i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x: section i >> 12, cell i & 4095. World generators still write flat arrays
// (beginFlat), packed when the chunk is done.
const SEC_IDENT = new Uint16Array(MAX_BLOCKS);
for (let i = 0; i < MAX_BLOCKS; i++) SEC_IDENT[i] = i;
const SEC_LUT = new Int16Array(MAX_BLOCKS).fill(-1),
  PK_P = new Uint16Array(256),
  PK_D = new Uint8Array(4096);
const newBlockSec = () => ({
  p: new Uint16Array(256),
  n: 1,
  d: new Uint8Array(4096)
}); // all p[0] = air
function secIndex(s, id) {
  const p = s.p,
    n = s.n;
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) if (p[k] === id) return k;
  if (n < 256) {
    p[n] = id;
    s.n = n + 1;
    return n;
  }
  return -1;
}
// a full palette: drop the entries no cell uses any more, or switch the section to plain ids
function secMakeRoom(s) {
  const used = new Uint8Array(256),
    d = s.d,
    p = s.p;
  for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) used[d[j]] = 1;
  const remap = new Uint8Array(256),
    np = new Uint16Array(256);
  let n = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 256; k++) if (used[k]) {
    remap[k] = n;
    np[n++] = p[k];
  }
  if (n < 256) {
    for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) d[j] = remap[d[j]];
    s.p = np;
    s.n = n;
    return;
  }
  const ids = new Uint16Array(4096);
  for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) ids[j] = p[d[j]];
  s.d = ids;
  s.p = SEC_IDENT;
  s.n = -1;
}
let FLAT_B = null,
  FLAT_M = null,
  FLAT_L = null; // scratch flat arrays (saving, lighting)
function flatScratch() {
  if (!FLAT_B || FLAT_B.length !== 256 * HEIGHT) {
    FLAT_B = new Uint16Array(256 * HEIGHT);
    FLAT_M = new Uint8Array(256 * HEIGHT);
    FLAT_L = new Uint8Array(256 * HEIGHT);
  }
}
class Chunk {
  constructor(cx, cz) {
    this.cx = cx;
    this.cz = cz;
    this.bs = new Array(SECTIONS).fill(null);
    this.ms = new Array(SECTIONS).fill(null);
    this.ls = new Array(SECTIONS).fill(null);
    this.lu = new Uint8Array(SECTIONS);
    this.blocks = null;
    this.meta = null; // flat arrays only while a generator fills the chunk
    this.grass = new Uint8Array(256 * 3); // biome tint per column
    this.foliage = new Uint8Array(256 * 3);
    this.biome = new Uint8Array(256);
    this.dirty = 0; // bitmask of sections needing remesh
    this.lit = false;
    this.modified = false;
    this.sectionCount = new Uint16Array(SECTIONS); // non-air block count per section
  }
  // a chunk built from flat block / meta arrays (made elsewhere, e.g. a worker)
  static from(cx, cz, blocks, meta) {
    const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz);
    ch.packFrom(blocks, meta);
    return ch;
  }
  // a chunk sent from a worker as sections (Chunk.prototype.wire)
  static fromWire(cx, cz, s) {
    const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz);
    for (const b of s.bs) if (b && b.n < 0) b.p = SEC_IDENT;
    ch.bs = s.bs;
    ch.ms = s.ms;
    if (s.ls) {
      ch.ls = s.ls;
      ch.lu = s.lu;
      ch.lit = true;
    }
    ch.recount();
    return ch;
  }
  // the sections for postMessage, and the buffers to transfer (the chunk can't be used afterwards)
  wire(light) {
    const tr = [],
      bs = this.bs.map(b => {
        if (!b) return null;
        tr.push(b.d.buffer);
        if (b.n < 0) return {
          p: null,
          n: -1,
          d: b.d
        };
        tr.push(b.p.buffer);
        return b;
      });
    for (const m of this.ms) if (m) tr.push(m.buffer);
    const o = {
      bs,
      ms: this.ms
    };
    if (light) {
      for (const l of this.ls) if (l) tr.push(l.buffer);
      o.ls = this.ls;
      o.lu = this.lu;
      tr.push(this.lu.buffer);
    }
    return [o, tr];
  }
  idx(x, y, z) {
    return y << 8 | z << 4 | x;
  }
  // ---- cell access (i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x) ----
  getB(i) {
    const s = this.bs[i >> 12];
    return s === null ? 0 : s.p[s.d[i & 4095]];
  }
  setB(i, id) {
    const si = i >> 12;
    let s = this.bs[si];
    if (s === null) {
      if (!id) return;
      s = this.bs[si] = newBlockSec();
    }
    if (s.n < 0) {
      s.d[i & 4095] = id;
      return;
    }
    let k = secIndex(s, id);
    if (k < 0) {
      secMakeRoom(s);
      if (s.n < 0) {
        s.d[i & 4095] = id;
        return;
      }
      k = secIndex(s, id);
    }
    s.d[i & 4095] = k;
  }
  getM(i) {
    const s = this.ms[i >> 12];
    return s === null ? 0 : s[i & 4095];
  }
  setM(i, v) {
    let s = this.ms[i >> 12];
    if (s === null) {
      if (!v) return;
      s = this.ms[i >> 12] = new Uint8Array(4096);
    }
    s[i & 4095] = v;
  }
  getL(i) {
    const s = this.ls[i >> 12];
    return s === null ? this.lu[i >> 12] : s[i & 4095];
  }
  setL(i, v) {
    const si = i >> 12;
    let s = this.ls[si];
    if (s === null) {
      const u = this.lu[si];
      if (u === v) return;
      s = this.ls[si] = new Uint8Array(4096);
      if (u) s.fill(u);
    }
    s[i & 4095] = v;
  }
  // ---- flat arrays <-> sections ----
  beginFlat() {
    this.blocks = new Uint16Array(256 * HEIGHT);
    this.meta = new Uint8Array(256 * HEIGHT);
    return this;
  }
  pack() {
    const B = this.blocks,
      M = this.meta;
    this.blocks = this.meta = null;
    this.packFrom(B, M);
  }
  packFrom(B, M) {
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const o = s << 12;
      let n = 0,
        cnt = 0;
      const p = PK_P,
        d = PK_D;
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const id = B[o + j];
        if (id) cnt++;
        let k = SEC_LUT[id];
        if (k < 0) {
          if (n === 256) {
            n = -1;
            break;
          }
          k = SEC_LUT[id] = n;
          p[n++] = id;
        }
        d[j] = k;
      }
      for (let k = 0; k < (n < 0 ? 256 : n); k++) SEC_LUT[p[k]] = -1;
      if (n < 0) {
        // more than 256 kinds: plain ids
        cnt = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) if (B[o + j]) cnt++;
        this.bs[s] = {
          p: SEC_IDENT,
          n: -1,
          d: B.slice(o, o + 4096)
        };
      } else this.bs[s] = cnt ? {
        p: p.slice(),
        n,
        d: d.slice()
      } : null;
      this.sectionCount[s] = cnt;
      let mz = true;
      if (M) for (let j = o; j < o + 4096; j++) if (M[j]) {
        mz = false;
        break;
      }
      this.ms[s] = mz ? null : new Uint8Array(M.subarray(o, o + 4096));
    }
  }
  // sections -> flat arrays (into the given ones, or scratch arrays that the next call reuses)
  flatBlocks(out) {
    out = out || (flatScratch(), FLAT_B);
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const b = this.bs[s],
        o = s << 12;
      if (!b) {
        out.fill(0, o, o + 4096);
        continue;
      }
      const p = b.p,
        d = b.d;
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) out[o + j] = p[d[j]];
    }
    return out;
  }
  flatMeta(out) {
    out = out || (flatScratch(), FLAT_M);
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const m = this.ms[s],
        o = s << 12;
      if (m) out.set(m, o);else out.fill(0, o, o + 4096);
    }
    return out;
  }
  // light computed into a flat array: sections that are one value keep no array
  packLight(L) {
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const o = s << 12,
        v = L[o];
      let uni = true;
      for (let j = o + 1; j < o + 4096; j++) if (L[j] !== v) {
        uni = false;
        break;
      }
      if (uni) {
        this.ls[s] = null;
        this.lu[s] = v;
      } else this.ls[s] = L.slice(o, o + 4096);
    }
  }
  // drop light arrays that became one value again
  compactLight() {
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const l = this.ls[s];
      if (!l) continue;
      const v = l[0];
      let uni = true;
      for (let j = 1; j < 4096; j++) if (l[j] !== v) {
        uni = false;
        break;
      }
      if (uni) {
        this.ls[s] = null;
        this.lu[s] = v;
      }
    }
  }
  // every cell holding one of the ids (palette check first: most sections hold none)
  findAll(ids, fn) {
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const b = this.bs[s];
      if (!b) continue;
      if (b.n >= 0) {
        let any = false;
        for (let k = 0; k < b.n; k++) if (ids.includes(b.p[k])) {
          any = true;
          break;
        }
        if (!any) continue;
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) {
        const id = b.p[b.d[j]];
        if (ids.includes(id)) fn(s << 12 | j, id);
      }
    }
  }
  recount() {
    if (this.blocks) {
      // still flat (a generator's)
      this.sectionCount.fill(0);
      const b = this.blocks;
      for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) if (b[i]) this.sectionCount[i >> 12]++;
      return;
    }
    for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
      const b = this.bs[s];
      let c = 0;
      if (b) {
        const p = b.p,
          d = b.d;
        for (let j = 0; j < 4096; j++) if (p[d[j]]) c++;
      }
      if (!c) this.bs[s] = null;
      this.sectionCount[s] = c;
    }
  }
}

// ---- a chunk's own light, worked out on flat scratch arrays (the borders come later: World.exchangeLight) ----
// Runs in the chunk worker for streamed chunks; the page only does it for chunks made there.
const LIGHT_H = new Int16Array(256);
function lightChunk(ch, hasSky) {
  flatScratch();
  const B = ch.blocks || ch.flatBlocks(),
    M = ch.meta,
    L = FLAT_L,
    heights = LIGHT_H,
    q = [];
  L.fill(0);
  if (hasSky) {
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      let l = 15,
        top = 0;
      for (let y = HEIGHT - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x,
          op = OPACITY[B[i]];
        if (op >= 15) l = 0;else if (op > 0 || l < 15) l = Math.max(0, l - Math.max(1, op));
        if (l === 15) top = y;
        L[i] = l << 4;
        if (l === 0) break;
      }
      heights[z * 16 + x] = top;
    }
    // horizontal sky seeds: the open sides of columns next to lower ones
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      const h = heights[z * 16 + x];
      let mx = h;
      if (x > 0) mx = Math.max(mx, heights[z * 16 + x - 1]);
      if (x < 15) mx = Math.max(mx, heights[z * 16 + x + 1]);
      if (z > 0) mx = Math.max(mx, heights[z * 16 + x - 16]);
      if (z < 15) mx = Math.max(mx, heights[z * 16 + x + 16]);
      for (let y = h; y <= mx && y < HEIGHT; y++) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x;
        if (L[i] >> 4 > 1) q.push(i);
      }
    }
    propagateFlat(B, L, q, 4);
    q.length = 0;
  }
  // block light: only sections whose palette holds a light source
  for (let s = 0; s < SECTIONS; s++) {
    if (!ch.blocks) {
      const b = ch.bs[s];
      if (!b) continue;
      if (b.n >= 0) {
        let any = false;
        for (let k = 0; k < b.n; k++) if (EMIT[b.p[k]]) {
          any = true;
          break;
        }
        if (!any) continue;
      }
    }
    for (let i = s << 12, e0 = i + 4096; i < e0; i++) {
      const id = B[i];
      if (!EMIT[id]) continue;
      const e = emitOf(id, M ? M[i] : ch.getM(i), ch.wl && ch.wl.has(i));
      if (e) {
        L[i] = L[i] & 0xF0 | e;
        q.push(i);
      }
    }
  }
  propagateFlat(B, L, q, 0);
  ch.packLight(L);
  ch.lit = true;
}
// BFS inside one chunk, q holds flat indices (World.propagate is the world-wide one)
function propagateFlat(B, L, q, shift) {
  const sky = shift === 4,
    top = HEIGHT - 1;
  for (let h = 0; h < q.length; h++) {
    const i = q[h],
      l = L[i] >> shift & 15;
    if (l <= 1) continue;
    const x = i & 15,
      z = i >> 4 & 15,
      y = i >> 8;
    for (let d = 0; d < 6; d++) {
      let n;
      switch (d) {
        case 0:
          if (x === 0) continue;
          n = i - 1;
          break;
        case 1:
          if (x === 15) continue;
          n = i + 1;
          break;
        case 2:
          if (y === 0) continue;
          n = i - 256;
          break;
        case 3:
          if (y === top) continue;
          n = i + 256;
          break;
        case 4:
          if (z === 0) continue;
          n = i - 16;
          break;
        default:
          if (z === 15) continue;
          n = i + 16;
      }
      const op = OPACITY[B[n]];
      if (op >= 15) continue;
      const nl = sky && d === 2 && l === 15 && op === 0 ? 15 : l - (op > 1 ? op : 1);
      const c = L[n];
      if (nl > (c >> shift & 15)) {
        L[n] = sky ? c & 0x0F | nl << 4 : c & 0xF0 | nl;
        q.push(n);
      }
    }
  }
}
const BIOMES = ['海洋', '沙滩', '平原', '森林', '桦木森林', '针叶林', '雪原', '沙漠', '山地', '河流', '雪山', '冻洋', '下界荒地', '末地'];
// vanilla temperatures of the matching biomes (sky colour, etc.)
// vanilla water colours by biome (default #3F76E4; frozen ocean #3938C9)
const BIOME_WATER_DEFAULT = [63, 118, 228];
const BIOME_WATER = [];
BIOME_WATER[11] = [57, 56, 201];
const DRY_FOLIAGE_DEFAULT = [92, 60, 50]; // (vanilla DryFoliageColor.FOLIAGE_DRY_DEFAULT: leaf litter)
const BIOME_TEMP = [0.5, 0.8, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6, 0.25, 0.0, 2.0, 0.2, 0.5, -0.7, 0.0, 2.0, 0.5];
function hsv2rgb(h, s, v) {
  const i = Math.floor(h * 6),
    f = h * 6 - i,
    p = v * (1 - s),
    q = v * (1 - f * s),
    t = v * (1 - (1 - f) * s);
  return [[v, t, p], [q, v, p], [p, v, t], [p, q, v], [t, p, v], [v, p, q]][(i % 6 + 6) % 6];
}
const BI = {
  OCEAN: 0,
  BEACH: 1,
  PLAINS: 2,
  FOREST: 3,
  BIRCH: 4,
  TAIGA: 5,
  SNOWY: 6,
  DESERT: 7,
  MOUNTAIN: 8,
  RIVER: 9,
  SNOWPEAK: 10,
  FROZEN_OCEAN: 11,
  NETHER: 12,
  END: 13
};

// Collects structure blocks into per-chunk buckets so each chunk can apply its own part
class StructBuilder {
  constructor() {
    this.buckets = new Map();
  }
  set(x, y, z, id, meta = 0) {
    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return;
    const k = ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4);
    let b = this.buckets.get(k);
    if (!b) this.buckets.set(k, b = []);
    b.push(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15, id, meta);
  }
  fill(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, id, meta = 0) {
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) this.set(x, y, z, typeof id === 'function' ? id(x, y, z) : id, meta);
  }
  box(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, wall, inner = AIR) {
    // hollow box: walls/floor/ceiling + carved interior
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let z = z0; z <= z1; z++) {
      const edge = x === x0 || x === x1 || y === y0 || y === y1 || z === z0 || z === z1;
      if (edge) {
        const w = typeof wall === 'function' ? wall(x, y, z) : wall;
        if (w !== null) this.set(x, y, z, w);
      } else this.set(x, y, z, inner);
    }
  }
  apply(ch) {
    const b = this.buckets.get(ckey(ch.cx, ch.cz));
    if (!b) return false;
    if (ch.blocks) for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 3) {
      ch.blocks[b[i]] = b[i + 1];
      ch.meta[b[i]] = b[i + 2];
    } else for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 3) {
      ch.setB(b[i], b[i + 1]);
      ch.setM(b[i], b[i + 2]);
    }
    return true;
  }
}
class World {
  constructor(seed, dim = 'overworld') {
    this.seed = seed | 0;
    this.dim = dim;
    this.hasSky = dim === 'overworld';
    this.structCache = new Map();
    this.nNether = new Noise(seed + 101);
    this.nNether2 = new Noise(seed + 102);
    this.nEnd = new Noise(seed + 201);
    if (dim === 'end') this.initEnd();
    this.chunks = new Map();
    this.nCont = new Noise(seed);
    this.nErosion = new Noise(seed + 1);
    this.nPeaks = new Noise(seed + 2);
    this.nHills = new Noise(seed + 3);
    this.nTemp = new Noise(seed + 4);
    this.nHumid = new Noise(seed + 5);
    this.nCave1 = new Noise(seed + 6);
    this.nCave2 = new Noise(seed + 7);
    this.nCave3 = new Noise(seed + 8);
    this.nRiver = new Noise(seed + 9);
    this.nSurf = new Noise(seed + 10);
    this.listener = null; // game hooks
    this.ticks = new Map(); // scheduled block ticks: key -> {x,y,z,t}
    this.time = 0; // game tick counter
    this.savedChunks = null; // map key -> saved data, filled by save system
    this.lightQ = [];
    this.grassMap = null;
    this.foliageMap = null;
  }

  // ---- access -------------------------------------------------------------
  getChunk(cx, cz) {
    return this.chunks.get(ckey(cx, cz));
  }
  getBlock(x, y, z) {
    if (y < 0) return this.dim === 'end' ? 0 : 6;
    if (y >= HEIGHT) return 0;
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    return c ? c.getB(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15) : 0;
  }
  getMeta(x, y, z) {
    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return 0;
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    return c ? c.getM(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15) : 0;
  }
  // waterlogged blocks (vanilla's waterlogged=true: a stair, slab, fence ... with water in its cell): a set of block
  // indices per chunk (chunk.wl), saved with it; the block keeps its own id and meta
  isWaterlogged(x, y, z) {
    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return false;
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    return !!(c && c.wl && c.wl.has(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15));
  }
  setWaterlogged(x, y, z, v) {
    if (y < 0 || y >= HEIGHT) return;
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    if (!c) return;
    const i = y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15;
    if (!!(c.wl && c.wl.has(i)) === !!v) return;
    if (v) (c.wl || (c.wl = new Set())).add(i);else c.wl.delete(i);
    c.modified = true;
    this.markBlock(c, x & 15, y, z & 15);
    if (WET_EMIT[c.getB(i)]) this.relight(x, y, z);
    this.notify(x, y, z, -1);
    for (let d = 0; d < 6; d++) this.notify(x + DIRS[d][0], y + DIRS[d][1], z + DIRS[d][2], -1);
  }
  // water in this cell: a water block, one that always holds water (seagrass, kelp ...) or a waterlogged one
  waterAt(x, y, z) {
    const id = this.getBlock(x, y, z);
    return id === WATER || !!WLOG[id] || id !== 0 && this.isWaterlogged(x, y, z);
  }
  // how much of a fluid a cell holds (vanilla FluidState.getAmount: 8 for a source or a falling one, else 8 less its
  // level; waterlogged and always-wet blocks hold a water source); 0 none, -1 the other fluid
  fluidAmount(id, x, y, z) {
    const b = this.getBlock(x, y, z);
    if (b === id) {
      const m = this.getMeta(x, y, z);
      return m === 0 || m & 8 ? 8 : 8 - (m & 7);
    }
    const wet = b !== 0 && (WLOG[b] || this.isWaterlogged(x, y, z));
    if (wet) return id === WATER ? 8 : -1;
    return IS_FLUID[b] ? -1 : 0;
  }
  // the way a fluid flows in a cell, normalised (FlowingFluid.getFlow): toward the lower sides - an empty side
  // counts by the fluid below it - and, for a falling one against a wall, mostly down
  fluidFlow(id, x, y, z) {
    const own = this.fluidAmount(id, x, y, z) / 9;
    let dx = 0,
      dz = 0;
    for (const [ox, oz] of FLUID_HDIRS) {
      const a = this.fluidAmount(id, x + ox, y, z + oz);
      if (a < 0) continue;
      let f1 = 0;
      if (a === 0) {
        if (!BLOCKS[this.getBlock(x + ox, y, z + oz)].solid) {
          const ab = this.fluidAmount(id, x + ox, y - 1, z + oz);
          if (ab > 0) f1 = own - (ab / 9 - 0.8888889);
        }
      } else f1 = own - a / 9;
      dx += ox * f1;
      dz += oz * f1;
    }
    let v = [dx, 0, dz];
    if (this.getBlock(x, y, z) === id && this.getMeta(x, y, z) & 8) {
      for (const [ox, oz] of FLUID_HDIRS) {
        if (!SOLIDCUBE[this.getBlock(x + ox, y, z + oz)] && !SOLIDCUBE[this.getBlock(x + ox, y + 1, z + oz)]) continue;
        const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        v = l > 0 ? [dx / l, -6, dz / l] : [0, -6, 0];
        break;
      }
    }
    const L = Math.hypot(v[0], v[1], v[2]);
    return L > 0 ? [v[0] / L, v[1] / L, v[2] / L] : v;
  }
  // which of the 4 x 4 samples of a cell's face toward DIRS[d] its block's collision shape covers (0xffff: all)
  faceMask(x, y, z, d) {
    const id = this.getBlock(x, y, z),
      b = BLOCKS[id];
    if (!b || !b.solid || IS_FLUID[id]) return 0;
    if (b.shape === SH_CUBE) return 0xffff;
    if (b.shape !== SH_BOXES && b.shape !== SH_MODEL) return 0;
    const a = d >> 1,
      u = (a + 1) % 3,
      v = (a + 2) % 3;
    let m = 0;
    for (const bx of b.boxes(this.getMeta(x, y, z)) || []) {
      if (d & 1 ? bx[a + 3] < 16 : bx[a] > 0) continue;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        const su = i * 4 + 2,
          sv = j * 4 + 2;
        if (bx[u] <= su && su < bx[u + 3] && bx[v] <= sv && sv < bx[v + 3]) m |= 1 << i * 4 + j;
      }
    }
    return m;
  }
  // FlowingFluid.canPassThroughWall: fluid gets from a cell to its neighbour toward DIRS[d] unless the two blocks'
  // shapes together close the face between them (a waterlogged bottom slab keeps its water from going down)
  fluidPass(x, y, z, d) {
    return (this.faceMask(x, y, z, d) | this.faceMask(x + DIRS[d][0], y + DIRS[d][1], z + DIRS[d][2], d ^ 1)) !== 0xffff;
  }
  fenceMeta(x, y, z, b) {
    return connBits(b, (dx, dz) => this.getBlock(x + dx, y, z + dz));
  }
  isLoaded(x, z) {
    return this.chunks.has(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
  }
  getLight(x, y, z) {
    if (y >= HEIGHT) return 0xF0;
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    return c ? c.getL(y << 8 | (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15) : this.hasSky ? 0xF0 : 0;
  }
  skyAt(x, y, z) {
    return this.getLight(x, y, z) >> 4;
  }
  blockLightAt(x, y, z) {
    return this.getLight(x, y, z) & 15;
  }
  surfaceY(x, z, fluids) {
    // from the top section down, skipping the empty ones: while it rains this runs for 441 columns a frame (rain
    // or snow, isCold), and going block by block from the build limit cost several ms a frame. fluids: water and
    // lava (and what is always in water) count as the top too - the maps' surface
    const c = this.chunks.get(ckey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
    if (!c) return 0;
    const col = (z & 15) << 4 | x & 15;
    for (let s = SECTIONS - 1; s >= 0; s--) {
      if (c.bs[s] === null) continue;
      for (let y = Math.min(HEIGHT - 1, s * 16 + 15); y >= s * 16 && y > 0; y--) {
        const b = c.getB(y << 8 | col);
        if (b && (BLOCKS[b].solid || fluids && (IS_FLUID[b] || WLOG[b]))) return y;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

  // ---- terrain functions -----------------------------------------------------
  column(x, z) {
    const cont = this.nCont.fbm2(x / 900, z / 900, 4) * 1.4;
    const ero = this.nErosion.fbm2(x / 500, z / 500, 3);
    const pk = 1 - Math.abs(this.nPeaks.fbm2(x / 280, z / 280, 4));
    const hills = this.nHills.fbm2(x / 140, z / 140, 4);
    const det = this.nHills.n2(x / 32 + 100, z / 32);
    // continentalness spline
    let h;
    if (cont < -0.45) h = lerp(30, 40, (cont + 1) / 0.55);else if (cont < -0.18) h = lerp(40, 55, (cont + 0.45) / 0.27);else if (cont < -0.06) h = lerp(55, 62, (cont + 0.18) / 0.12);else if (cont < 0.05) h = lerp(62, 66, (cont + 0.06) / 0.11);else h = lerp(66, 78, clamp((cont - 0.05) / 0.6, 0, 1));
    const land = smoothstep(-0.1, 0.1, cont);
    const mount = smoothstep(0.02, 0.45, cont) * smoothstep(0.05, -0.35, ero);
    h += mount * pk * pk * 95;
    h += hills * (5 + 10 * land) * (0.6 + mount) + det * 2;
    // rivers
    const rv = Math.abs(this.nRiver.fbm2(x / 420, z / 420, 3));
    let river = 0;
    if (cont > -0.12) {
      river = 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.045, rv);
      const target = 57;
      if (river > 0 && h > target) h = lerp(h, target, river * (h > 100 ? 0.5 : 1));
    }
    const temp = this.nTemp.fbm2(x / 1100, z / 1100, 3) * 1.6 + this.nSurf.n2(x / 40, z / 40) * 0.03;
    const humid = this.nHumid.fbm2(x / 900, z / 900, 3) * 1.6;
    return {
      h: Math.floor(h),
      temp,
      humid,
      river,
      cont,
      mount
    };
  }
  biomeOf(col) {
    const h = col.h,
      t = col.temp,
      hu = col.humid;
    if (h < SEA - 3) return col.river > 0.5 && col.cont > -0.12 ? BI.RIVER : t < -0.5 ? BI.FROZEN_OCEAN : BI.OCEAN;
    if (h <= SEA + 1 && col.river > 0.3) return BI.RIVER;
    if (h <= SEA + 2 && col.cont < 0.02) return t > 0.35 && hu < 0.1 ? BI.DESERT : BI.BEACH;
    if (h > 118) return BI.SNOWPEAK;
    if (h > 98 && col.mount > 0.3) return BI.MOUNTAIN;
    if (t > 0.35 && hu < 0.1) return BI.DESERT;
    if (t < -0.42) return BI.SNOWY;
    if (t < -0.15) return BI.TAIGA;
    if (hu > 0.38 && t > -0.05) return BI.BIRCH;
    if (hu > 0.08) return BI.FOREST;
    return BI.PLAINS;
  }
  tintFor(map, temp, humid, out, o) {
    const T = clamp(0.62 + temp * 0.45, 0, 1),
      H = clamp(0.5 + humid * 0.5, 0, 1) * T;
    const px = Math.floor((1 - T) * 255),
      py = Math.floor((1 - H) * 255);
    const i = (py * 256 + px) * 4;
    out[o] = map[i];
    out[o + 1] = map[i + 1];
    out[o + 2] = map[i + 2];
  }

  // ---- generation ------------------------------------------------------------
  generateFlat(cx, cz) {
    // vanilla classic flat: bedrock, 2 dirt, grass (flatTop 3); older superflat worlds: stone up to 56, 3 dirt, grass at 60
    const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz).beginFlat(),
      top = this.flatTop || 60;
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      for (let y = 0; y <= top; y++) ch.blocks[y << 8 | z << 4 | x] = y === 0 ? 6 : y < top - 3 ? 1 : y < top ? 3 : 2;
      ch.biome[z * 16 + x] = BI.PLAINS;
      this.tintFor(this.grassMap, 0.3, 0.2, ch.grass, (z * 16 + x) * 3);
      this.tintFor(this.foliageMap, 0.3, 0.2, ch.foliage, (z * 16 + x) * 3);
    }
    ch.recount();
    return ch;
  }
  generate(cx, cz) {
    let ch;
    if (this.dim === 'nether') ch = this.generateNether(cx, cz);else if (this.dim === 'end') ch = this.generateEnd(cx, cz);else if (this.flat) ch = this.generateFlat(cx, cz);else ch = this.generateOverworld(cx, cz);
    for (const sb of this.structuresFor(cx, cz)) sb.apply(ch);
    ch.pack();
    return ch;
  }
  generateOverworld(cx, cz) {
    const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz).beginFlat();
    const B = ch.blocks,
      M = ch.meta;
    const x0 = cx * 16,
      z0 = cz * 16;
    const seed = this.seed;
    // columns incl. 1-block border for slope
    const cols = new Array(18 * 18);
    for (let z = -1; z < 17; z++) for (let x = -1; x < 17; x++) cols[(z + 1) * 18 + x + 1] = this.column(x0 + x, z0 + z);
    let maxH = 0;
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      const c = cols[(z + 1) * 18 + x + 1];
      maxH = Math.max(maxH, c.h);
      const bi = this.biomeOf(c);
      ch.biome[z * 16 + x] = bi;
      this.tintFor(this.grassMap, c.temp, c.humid, ch.grass, (z * 16 + x) * 3);
      this.tintFor(this.foliageMap, c.temp, c.humid, ch.foliage, (z * 16 + x) * 3);
    }
    // cave noise on a coarse grid (4x8x4) then trilinear interpolation
    const gy = Math.min(HEIGHT, maxH + 9) >> 3;
    const GX = 5,
      GY = gy + 1,
      GZ = 5;
    const g1 = new Float32Array(GX * GY * GZ),
      g2 = new Float32Array(GX * GY * GZ),
      g3 = new Float32Array(GX * GY * GZ);
    for (let ix = 0; ix < GX; ix++) for (let iz = 0; iz < GZ; iz++) for (let iy = 0; iy < GY; iy++) {
      const wx = x0 + ix * 4,
        wy = iy * 8,
        wz = z0 + iz * 4;
      const i = (ix * GZ + iz) * GY + iy;
      g1[i] = this.nCave1.n3(wx / 48, wy / 32, wz / 48);
      g2[i] = this.nCave2.n3(wx / 48, wy / 32, wz / 48);
      g3[i] = this.nCave3.n3(wx / 90, wy / 40, wz / 90);
    }
    const sample = (g, x, y, z) => {
      const fx = x / 4,
        fy = y / 8,
        fz = z / 4;
      const ix = Math.min(fx | 0, GX - 2),
        iy = Math.min(fy | 0, GY - 2),
        iz = Math.min(fz | 0, GZ - 2);
      const tx = fx - ix,
        ty = fy - iy,
        tz = fz - iz;
      const i000 = (ix * GZ + iz) * GY + iy,
        i100 = ((ix + 1) * GZ + iz) * GY + iy;
      const i010 = i000 + 1,
        i110 = i100 + 1,
        i001 = i000 + GY,
        i101 = i100 + GY,
        i011 = i001 + 1,
        i111 = i101 + 1;
      const a = lerp(lerp(g[i000], g[i100], tx), lerp(g[i001], g[i101], tx), tz);
      const b = lerp(lerp(g[i010], g[i110], tx), lerp(g[i011], g[i111], tx), tz);
      return lerp(a, b, ty);
    };
    const rng = RNG(hashStr(seed + ':' + cx + ':' + cz));
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      const ci = (z + 1) * 18 + x + 1,
        c = cols[ci];
      const h = c.h,
        bi = ch.biome[z * 16 + x];
      const slope = Math.max(Math.abs(cols[ci - 1].h - cols[ci + 1].h), Math.abs(cols[ci - 18].h - cols[ci + 18].h));
      const wx = x0 + x,
        wz = z0 + z;
      let top,
        filler,
        fillDepth = 3 + (hash3(wx, 0, wz, seed) * 2 | 0);
      if (bi === BI.DESERT) {
        top = 9;
        filler = 9;
        fillDepth = 4;
      } else if (bi === BI.BEACH) {
        top = 9;
        filler = 9;
      } else if (bi === BI.OCEAN || bi === BI.FROZEN_OCEAN || bi === BI.RIVER) {
        const n = this.nSurf.n2(wx / 12, wz / 12);
        top = h < SEA - 1 ? n > 0.35 ? 10 : n < -0.5 ? 36 : 9 : 9;
        filler = top === 36 ? 36 : 9;
        if (bi === BI.RIVER && h >= SEA - 1) {
          top = 9;
        }
      } else if (bi === BI.MOUNTAIN || bi === BI.SNOWPEAK) {
        top = slope > 3 ? 1 : 2;
        filler = slope > 3 ? 1 : 3;
        if (h > 135 + hash3(wx, 1, wz, seed) * 6) {
          top = 33;
        }
      } else {
        top = 2;
        filler = 3;
      }
      if (slope > 5 && top === 2) {
        top = 1;
        filler = 1;
      }
      for (let y = 0; y <= h && y < HEIGHT; y++) {
        let id;
        if (y === 0) id = 6;else if (y < 4 && hash3(wx, y, wz, seed) < (4 - y) / 4) id = 6;else if (y === h) id = top;else if (y > h - fillDepth) id = filler;else if (bi === BI.DESERT && y > h - fillDepth - 3) id = 17;else id = y < 8 || y < 16 && hash3(wx, y, wz, seed + 77) < (16 - y) / 8 ? 75 : 1;
        // caves
        if (y > 4 && id !== 6) {
          const nearSurf = y > h - 5;
          const wet = h < SEA + 2;
          if (!(wet && y > h - 9)) {
            const a = sample(g1, x, y, z),
              b = sample(g2, x, y, z);
            const tun = a * a + b * b;
            let carve = tun < (nearSurf ? 0.006 : 0.011);
            if (!carve && y < 52 && !nearSurf) carve = sample(g3, x, y, z) > 0.62 - (52 - y) * 0.004;
            if (carve) id = y <= 10 ? LAVA : AIR;
          }
        }
        B[y << 8 | z << 4 | x] = id;
      }
      // water
      for (let y = h + 1; y <= SEA; y++) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x;
        if (B[i] === AIR) B[i] = y === SEA && (bi === BI.FROZEN_OCEAN || bi === BI.SNOWY && c.temp < -0.5) ? 35 : WATER;
      }
      // snow cover
      if ((bi === BI.SNOWY || bi === BI.SNOWPEAK || bi === BI.MOUNTAIN && h > 125) && h >= SEA && h + 1 < HEIGHT) {
        const ti = h << 8 | z << 4 | x;
        if (B[ti] === 2) M[ti] = 1;
        if (B[ti] !== AIR && B[ti] !== WATER && B[ti] !== 35 && B[ti] !== 33 && B[h + 1 << 8 | z << 4 | x] === AIR) B[h + 1 << 8 | z << 4 | x] = 34;
      }
    }
    this.genOres(ch, rng);
    if (rng() < 0.11 && this.structures !== false) this.genDungeon(ch, cols, rng);
    this.decorate(ch, cols);
    ch.recount();
    return ch;
  }

  // ---- Nether -----------------------------------------------------------------
  generateNether(cx, cz) {
    const ch = new Chunk(cx, cz).beginFlat(),
      B = ch.blocks,
      M = ch.meta;
    const x0 = cx * 16,
      z0 = cz * 16,
      seed = this.seed;
    // density on a 4x4x4 grid: big horizontally-stretched caverns, shelf-forming middle octave and a
    // rough small octave (vanilla's nether noise is squashed vertically, which gives ledges and overhangs)
    const GX = 5,
      GY = 33,
      GZ = 5,
      g = new Float32Array(GX * GY * GZ);
    for (let ix = 0; ix < GX; ix++) for (let iz = 0; iz < GZ; iz++) for (let iy = 0; iy < GY; iy++) {
      const wx = x0 + ix * 4,
        wy = iy * 4,
        wz = z0 + iz * 4;
      let d = this.nNether.n3(wx / 90, wy / 42, wz / 90) * 0.95 + this.nNether2.n3(wx / 34, wy / 13, wz / 34) * 0.42 + this.nNether.n3(wx / 11 + 300, wy / 8, wz / 11 - 300) * 0.16;
      d += Math.max(0, (18 - wy) / 9) + Math.max(0, (wy - 104) / 10);
      d -= Math.max(0, (52 - Math.abs(wy - 64)) / 52) * 0.22;
      g[(ix * GZ + iz) * GY + iy] = d;
    }
    const sample = (x, y, z) => {
      const fx = x / 4,
        fy = y / 4,
        fz = z / 4;
      const ix = Math.min(fx | 0, GX - 2),
        iy = Math.min(fy | 0, GY - 2),
        iz = Math.min(fz | 0, GZ - 2);
      const tx = fx - ix,
        ty = fy - iy,
        tz = fz - iz;
      const i000 = (ix * GZ + iz) * GY + iy,
        i100 = ((ix + 1) * GZ + iz) * GY + iy;
      const a = lerp(lerp(g[i000], g[i100], tx), lerp(g[i000 + GY], g[i100 + GY], tx), tz);
      const b = lerp(lerp(g[i000 + 1], g[i100 + 1], tx), lerp(g[i000 + GY + 1], g[i100 + GY + 1], tx), tz);
      return lerp(a, b, ty);
    };
    for (let z = 0; z < 16; z++) for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
      const wx = x0 + x,
        wz = z0 + z;
      ch.biome[z * 16 + x] = BI.NETHER;
      const soul = this.nNether2.n2(wx / 50, wz / 50) > 0.35,
        grav = this.nNether.n2(wx / 30 + 99, wz / 30) > 0.45;
      for (let y = 0; y < 128; y++) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x;
        let id;
        if (y === 0 || y === 127 || y < 5 && hash3(wx, y, wz, seed) < (5 - y) / 5 || y > 122 && hash3(wx, y, wz, seed + 1) < (y - 122) / 5) id = 6;else id = sample(x, y, z) > 0.0 ? 119 : y <= 31 ? LAVA : AIR;
        B[i] = id;
      }
      // surface dressing: soul sand / gravel floors, magma near the lava sea
      for (let y = 120; y > 5; y--) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x,
          above = B[y + 1 << 8 | z << 4 | x];
        if (B[i] !== 119 || above !== AIR) continue;
        if (soul && y > 31) {
          B[i] = 120;
          if (B[i - 256] === 119) B[i - 256] = 120;
        } else if (grav && y >= 30 && y <= 35) B[i] = 10;
        if (y > 32 && hash3(wx, y, wz, seed + 5) < 0.004) B[y + 1 << 8 | z << 4 | x] = 171;
      }
      for (let y = 26; y <= 34; y++) {
        const i = y << 8 | z << 4 | x;
        if (B[i] === 119 && this.nNether.n3(wx / 8, y / 8, wz / 8) > 0.45) B[i] = 103;
      }
    }
    // glowstone clusters hanging from ceilings (vanilla rule: start under netherrack, then only grow
    // into air that touches exactly one glowstone block -> compact dangling clumps, never loose strands)
    const rng = RNG(hashStr('nether' + seed + ':' + cx + ':' + cz));
    const at = (x, y, z) => x < 0 || x > 15 || z < 0 || z > 15 || y < 1 || y > 126 ? -1 : B[y << 8 | z << 4 | x];
    for (let n = 0; n < 12; n++) {
      const ox = 3 + rng.int(10),
        oz = 3 + rng.int(10),
        oy = 32 + rng.int(92);
      if (at(ox, oy, oz) !== AIR || at(ox, oy + 1, oz) !== 119) continue;
      B[oy << 8 | oz << 4 | ox] = 27;
      for (let k = 0; k < 900; k++) {
        const x = ox + rng.int(4) - rng.int(4),
          y = oy - rng.int(10),
          z = oz + rng.int(4) - rng.int(4);
        if (at(x, y, z) !== AIR) continue;
        let nb = 0;
        for (const D of DIRS) if (at(x + D[0], y + D[1], z + D[2]) === 27 && ++nb > 1) break;
        if (nb === 1) B[y << 8 | z << 4 | x] = 27;
      }
    }
    const vein = (ore, count, ymin, ymax, size) => {
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        let x = rng() * 16,
          y = ymin + rng() * (ymax - ymin),
          z = rng() * 16;
        for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
          const ix = x | 0,
            iy = y | 0,
            iz = z | 0;
          if (ix >= 0 && ix < 16 && iz >= 0 && iz < 16 && iy > 0 && iy < 127) {
            const q = iy << 8 | iz << 4 | ix;
            if (B[q] === 119) B[q] = ore;
          }
          x += rng() * 2 - 1;
          y += rng() * 2 - 1;
          z += rng() * 2 - 1;
        }
      }
    };
    vein(121, 14, 10, 117, 12);
    vein(122, 8, 10, 117, 8);
    ch.recount();
    return ch;
  }
  fortressAt(rx, rz) {
    const r = RNG(hashStr('fortress' + this.seed + ':' + rx + ':' + rz));
    if (r() > 0.9) return null;
    const S = 18;
    return {
      x: (rx * S + 3 + r.int(S - 6)) * 16 + 8,
      y: 58 + r.int(12),
      z: (rz * S + 3 + r.int(S - 6)) * 16 + 8,
      key: 'f' + rx + ',' + rz
    };
  }
  // fortresses around a position: gen-2 worlds get them from the vanilla structure placement (worker refs)
  fortressesNear(x, z, R = 2) {
    if (this.gen2) {
      const out = [];
      for (const r of (this.structRefs || new Map()).values()) if (r.f) out.push({
        x: r.f[0],
        y: r.f[1] - (this.minY || 0),
        z: r.f[2],
        key: 'v' + r.f[0] + ',' + r.f[2]
      });
      return out;
    }
    const S = 18 * 16,
      rx = Math.floor(x / S),
      rz = Math.floor(z / S),
      out = [];
    for (let a = -R; a <= R; a++) for (let b = -R; b <= R; b++) {
      const f = this.fortressAt(rx + a, rz + b);
      if (f) out.push(f);
    }
    return out;
  }
  nearestFortress(x, z) {
    let best = null,
      bd = 1e9;
    for (const f of this.fortressesNear(x, z)) {
      const d = Math.hypot(f.x - x, f.z - z);
      if (d < bd) {
        bd = d;
        best = f;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
  buildFortress(f) {
    const S = new StructBuilder(),
      NB = 123,
      FE = 124,
      X = f.x,
      Y = f.y,
      Z = f.z,
      L = 44;
    const r = RNG(hashStr(f.key + this.seed));
    // bridges in a cross
    for (const ax of [0, 1]) {
      for (let t = -L; t <= L; t++) {
        for (let w = -2; w <= 2; w++) {
          const x = ax ? X + w : X + t,
            z = ax ? Z + t : Z + w;
          S.set(x, Y, z, NB);
          for (let y = Y + 1; y <= Y + 5; y++) S.set(x, y, z, AIR);
          if (Math.abs(w) === 2) S.set(x, Y + 1, z, FE, ax ? 12 : 3);
        }
        if (Math.abs(t) % 10 === 5) {
          for (let y = Y - 1; y >= Math.max(12, Y - 50); y--) for (let w = -2; w <= 2; w++) for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
            const x = ax ? X + w : X + t + k,
              z = ax ? Z + t + k : Z + w;
            if (Math.abs(w) <= 1 || y < Y - 3) S.set(x, y, z, NB);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const room = (cx, cz, half, h) => {
      S.box(cx - half, Y, cz - half, cx + half, Y + h, cz + half, NB);
      for (let k = -half + 2; k <= half - 2; k += 3) for (const [dx, dz] of [[k, -half], [k, half], [-half, k], [half, k]]) {
        S.set(cx + dx, Y + 2, cz + dz, FE, 15);
        S.set(cx + dx, Y + 3, cz + dz, FE, 15);
      }
      for (const [dx, dz] of [[0, -half], [0, half], [-half, 0], [half, 0]]) for (let w = -1; w <= 1; w++) for (let y = Y + 1; y <= Y + 4; y++) S.set(cx + dx + (dz ? w : 0), y, cz + dz + (dx ? w : 0), AIR);
    };
    // central blaze room
    room(X, Z, 7, 7);
    S.fill(X - 1, Y + 1, Z - 1, X + 1, Y + 1, Z + 1, NB);
    S.set(X, Y + 2, Z, 127, 3);
    // arm ends: wart garden (east), treasure (west), open blaze balcony (south), stairs room (north)
    room(X + L, Z, 5, 6);
    for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
      S.set(X + L + dx, Y, Z + dz * 2, 120);
      S.set(X + L + dx, Y + 1, Z + dz * 2, 126, 3);
    }
    room(X - L, Z, 5, 6);
    S.set(X - L, Y + 1, Z - 3, 52, 5 | 8);
    S.set(X - L + 2, Y + 1, Z + 3, 52, 4 | 8);
    for (let dx = -4; dx <= 4; dx++) for (let dz = -4; dz <= 4; dz++) {
      S.set(X + dx, Y, Z + L + dz, NB);
      for (let y = Y + 1; y <= Y + 5; y++) S.set(X + dx, y, Z + L + dz, AIR);
      if (Math.abs(dx) === 4 || Math.abs(dz) === 4) S.set(X + dx, Y + 1, Z + L + dz, FE, 15);
    }
    S.fill(X - 1, Y + 1, Z + L - 1, X + 1, Y + 1, Z + L + 1, NB);
    S.set(X, Y + 2, Z + L, 127, 3);
    room(X, Z - L, 5, 6);
    // a staircase up eastwards on nether bricks (it was 4 stairs facing north hanging diagonally in the air)
    for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      for (let y = Y + 1; y <= Y + k; y++) S.set(X - 2 + k, y, Z - L + 3, NB);
      S.set(X - 2 + k, Y + 1 + k, Z - L + 3, 125, 0);
    }
    // a few torches-free glowstone lights inside rooms
    for (const [x, z] of [[X - 5, Z - 5], [X + 5, Z + 5], [X + L, Z], [X - L, Z]]) S.set(x, Y + 6, z, 27);
    return S;
  }

  // ---- Overworld strongholds -------------------------------------------------------
  strongholds() {
    if (this._sh) return this._sh;
    const r = RNG(hashStr('strongholds' + this.seed)),
      a0 = r() * Math.PI * 2,
      out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = a0 + i * Math.PI * 2 / 3 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.5,
        d = 640 + r() * 420;
      out.push({
        x: Math.floor(Math.cos(a) * d / 16) * 16 + 8,
        y: 26 + r.int(10),
        z: Math.floor(Math.sin(a) * d / 16) * 16 + 8,
        key: 'sh' + i
      });
    }
    return this._sh = out;
  }
  buildStronghold(h) {
    const S = new StructBuilder(),
      X = h.x,
      Y = h.y,
      Z = h.z;
    const r = RNG(hashStr(h.key + this.seed));
    const brick = () => {
      const v = r();
      return v < 0.7 ? 23 : v < 0.85 ? 94 : 93;
    };
    // portal room
    S.box(X - 6, Y - 1, Z - 8, X + 6, Y + 7, Z + 8, brick);
    S.fill(X - 4, Y, Z - 4, X + 4, Y, Z + 4, () => brick());
    S.fill(X - 1, Y - 1, Z - 1, X + 1, Y - 1, Z + 1, LAVA);
    S.fill(X - 1, Y, Z - 1, X + 1, Y, Z + 1, AIR);
    for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) {
      S.set(X + k, Y, Z - 2, 174, r() < 0.1 ? 4 : 0);
      S.set(X + k, Y, Z + 2, 174, r() < 0.1 ? 4 : 0);
      S.set(X - 2, Y, Z + k, 174, r() < 0.1 ? 4 : 0);
      S.set(X + 2, Y, Z + k, 174, r() < 0.1 ? 4 : 0);
    }
    for (let k = -1; k <= 1; k++) S.set(X + k, Y, Z + 5, 62, 3);
    // wall torches on the walls (meta 0 of the old torch is a standing one: two hung in the air)
    const wt = f => {
